banner.title: renovate-operator
banner.tagline: Runs Renovate hourly against skrumbach/home-ops as Kubernetes Jobs, with metrics and alerts for failed or missing runs.

art.about: a bot that opens dependency update pull requests on a schedule
art.title: From the top of the hour to a Renovate pull request

explainer.title: From the top of the hour to a dependency pull request

steps.title: Mint
steps.text: An ExternalSecret builds the GitHub App key from 1Password item renovate. The job exchanges it for an installation token.
steps.scene: a key being forged into a short-lived token

steps.title: Discover
steps.text: The RenovateJob home-ops runs at minute zero and finds skrumbach/home-ops through the App installation.
steps.scene: a magnifying lens over a repository icon

steps.title: Update
steps.text: Renovate reads the repo config and opens one pull request per dependency change, with platform commits on.
steps.scene: branch lines merging into a cyan pull request

steps.title: Record
steps.text: Each run is a Job kept for 24 hours. A failed run is not retried; the next hourly run is the retry.
steps.scene: a timeline of identical job cards

steps.title: Alarm
steps.text: Five rules cover failed runs, missing runs, empty discovery, a suspended job and an absent operator.
steps.scene: a bell with a small pulse of light
